title: fix(cli)!: refuse a production os serve whose @objectstack/plugin-auth fails to load, naming the load error
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuNsiqYysBbcDRE7iuEMwM2A)_

Fixes #25158

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Card thread of the `domain:cli` lane (seat post #6024, 由Sales账户的项目负责), session `session_01YD4v2ErCfZk8sfaZe8AYVu`, claim 6341648045. The rule is #25133's (ADR-0131 D9, ruling 6328987873's reasoning); this is the third composition that reaches the same state. Review tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, because the diff declares a narrowing. The branch is `claude/project-thread-m47h05`, not `claude/issue-25158-*`: this session can push only that branch, as the claim says.

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, the `5d` AuthPlugin auto-registration:

- **Before.** The `auth` tier is on and a secret resolved, so `resolvePlatformAuthComposition` composes AuthPlugin. The block's broad `try` wraps the `@objectstack/plugin-auth` import, the construction and the `kernel.use`. When any of them threw, the catch warned (or said nothing, for `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) and the boot went on with no AuthPlugin, so with no organization object.
- **After.** On a production boot (no `--dev`) whose rule composed AuthPlugin, a throw before AuthPlugin is mounted is recorded (`authPluginLoadFailure`). It is refused beside the two existing ADR-0131 D9 refusals, after composition and before anything starts, whether or not `--server`. The refusal names the load error verbatim and the remedy (reinstall the deployment's dependencies; `@objectstack/plugin-auth` is a dependency of `@objectstack/cli`). An `authPluginMounted` flag keeps a throw that happens after the mount on the old path.
- `const productionBoot = !isDev` moved up from the no-auth refusal so the catch can read it. That refusal's condition is unchanged.
- **Unchanged:**
  - `--dev` keeps the warn-and-boot path;
  - the host kernel: its rule composes nothing (`host-kernel`), so the catch keeps its old handling;
  - a production boot with no secret, or with no auth: still refused by the existing two refusals;
  - programmatic embedding, which never runs this command.

`scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`: its self-test pins the exact set of test files that spawn the built `bin/run.js`, and the new pin joins that set ("fourteen" becomes "fifteen"). The entry carries the same kind of reason as `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal`'s. This is the one line outside `packages/cli`; `scripts/` gates anchor to `domain:spec`, so it is declared here as a cross-lane touch.

## Pins

`packages/cli/test/serve-plugin-auth-load-failure-refusal.integration.test.ts`, 4 legs, next to `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts`. All legs spawn `bin/run.js` with `NODE_ENV` unset and `OS_AUTH_SECRET` set.

The load failure is stubbed with `packages/cli/test/fixtures/plugin-auth-load-failure.hook.mjs`, a `node --import` resolve hook. It denies only the package's root entry; the subpaths `@objectstack/runtime` imports stay reachable. In both modes node produces its own error:

- `?mode=missing` resolves to a path that does not exist (`Cannot find module '…'`);
- `?mode=broken` resolves to a module that cannot link (`The requested module 'node:path' does not provide an export named …`, the shape of the publish-smoke specimen).

The legs:

- **Refused, the database never opened, the load error named after `The load error: `, and no `⚠ AuthPlugin failed to load` line:**
  - a missing install, with `--server`;
  - a broken install, with `--no-server`.
- **Boots, reaching ready and opening the database:**
  - the same fixture and secret with no stub (`--no-server`);
  - the broken stub under `--dev --no-server`, which asserts the warn line still carries node's sentence.

The cause is asserted right after `The load error: ` because, with the stub on, oclif also prints a `ModuleLoadError` warning for the `verify` command: `@objectstack/verify` imports the root entry too. The hook's header says so.

## Proof

Local, on this branch:

- **The pin file:** 4/4, three runs at 13.3 s, 13.1 s and 12.4 s. It declares `test-budget: 20` (13.3 s × 1.25), with no CI reading yet.
- **Ablation:** the recording condition was turned off (`if (false && productionBoot …`) and the cli rebuilt; the marker is in `dist/commands/serve.js`. Result: 2 failed and 2 passed. Both refused legs are red with "the boot was not refused", and the broken leg shows the old `⚠ AuthPlugin failed to load:` line. The controls stay green. Restored with `git restore --source=HEAD`, blob `47ae01cd` == HEAD, rebuilt, and the marker is absent from `dist`.
- **The sibling pin `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts`:** 10/10.
- **cli typecheck:** exit 0.
- **cli unit layer:** `vitest run --project unit` reports 324/324 files and 4777/4777 tests.
- **`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`:** 101 families, each exit code captured before any pipe. The first sweep had one real finding and four prerequisite refusals:
  - `check:cli-test-child-env` (exit 1): its self-test pins the set of test files that spawn the built `bin/run.js`, and the new pin joins it. The new file is named there with the reason it needs production posture, the same way `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal` is.
  - exit 3, not measured: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (a shallow clone), and `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` (packages outside the cli closure were not built). All four re-ran at exit 0 after the pinned fixture commit was fetched and `pnpm build` ran.
  - The gate-script edit derives 20 more families (121 in all). They ran too, all at exit 0. `--ran` accounts for 121 of 121, with 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- **`pnpm lint`:** exit 0.
- **`check-governed-merges --branch`:** exit 0, NOT governed (0 of 7 paths), +335 / -10.

## Docs

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: the auth-tier paragraph names the third refusal.
- `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`: the 18.0 auth-secret paragraph covers a failed `@objectstack/plugin-auth` load, `os start` included. "Either refusal" becomes "any of these refusals", and the `os start` sentence is scoped to the missing-secret refusal.
- `content/docs/releases/**` is not touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **The refusal also covers a throw from the AuthPlugin construction, before the mount, not only from the import.** Either way no AuthPlugin and no organization object, and the error is named. The text says "failed to load", which reads a little wide for a constructor throw. I kept one sentence rather than branching the text on the stage.
- **`os start`'s `serve` child is a production boot**, so a broken install under `os start` is now refused too. It used to boot without auth.
